# ProxyGosha

> Zero-cost, single-file Telegram WEB Proxy running on Cloudflare Workers (v1.3.0). Unblock Telegram (Desktop, Android, and iOS) across all 6 Cloudflare HTTPS ports with no VPS, no maintenance, and 100% free serverless infrastructure. Primary documentation is Persian (README.md); source lives in src/ and builds to the committed single-file worker.js via esbuild.

## Overview
ProxyGosha transforms a free Cloudflare Worker (`worker.js`) into a high-performance Telegram WEB proxy server. It listens on all six Cloudflare HTTPS ports (443, 2053, 2083, 2087, 2096, 8443) over HTTPS and WebSockets, serves a per-deployment-branded decoy e-commerce landing page to unauthenticated web crawlers and active scanners, and tunnels MTProto traffic directly to official Telegram Data Centers (DCs 1–5, DC203) using raw TCP sockets (`cloudflare:sockets`).

## Key Features
- **Zero Cost & Serverless**: Runs on Cloudflare's free tier (100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU/request, 50 subrequests, 6 simultaneous connecting sockets, 128 MB memory per isolate).
- **Single File (`worker.js`)**: Pure JavaScript ES module; built from `src/` with esbuild; the built artifact is committed so dashboard paste still works.
- **6-Port DPI Bypass** with strict per-port secret isolation (legacy cross-port mode available via `LEGACY_PORT_SECRETS=1`).
- **Per-deployment camouflage (S2)**: decoy brand, palette, products, favicon, /health and the carrier API paths are deterministically derived from the deployment secret; every failure path answers exactly like an unknown path.
- **Fast Mode (Zero-CPU Downloads)**: DC-to-client payloads match the client cipher keystream, so heavy download traffic passes through untouched.
- **Real upstream batching (F1)**: queued client frames are coalesced up to 256 KiB (2x AES-CTR, one write, one WINDOW grant); byte-identical to the per-frame path (tested).
- **Fast DC connects (F2)**: per-isolate last-good endpoint memory, staggered parallel attempts, 60 s demotion; worst case under 3.5 s.
- **Hardened tokens (S4)**: host-bound HMAC tokens, 6 h session TTL with bridge-side bootstrap refresh, `KEY_EPOCH` mass revocation.
- **Cookie admin login (S3)**: HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict panel session, deprecated URL-key access kept working, coarse in-isolate failed-attempt backoff (no IP storage).
- **Independent SECRET (S1)**: recommended setup stores both ADMIN_KEY and an independent 32-hex SECRET; legacy ADMIN_KEY-only deployments keep v1.2.2-identical secrets (golden-tested) and get a panel warning plus the exact freeze value.
- **Per-user secrets (R1)**: HMAC-derived secrets from labels (`USER_SECRETS`), individually revocable.
- **Live Telemetry & DC Probe**: admin status dashboard (`/panel/status` or `/<ADMIN_KEY>/status`) with per-DC latency EMA, memory-guard readout, full environment report and an on-demand DC reachability probe (`?probe=1`).
- **Privacy-Preserving**: no client IPs, tokens or secrets are ever logged; telemetry lives only in isolate memory. The only optional outbound calls are `DECOY_URL` (edge-cached 60 s) and an explicit `ALERT_URL` webhook (off by default).

## Technical Specifications
- **Version**: 1.3.0
- **Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers (V8 isolate), module worker format.
- **Transport**: HTTPS & WSS on ports 443, 2053, 2083, 2087, 2096, 8443.
- **Carrier Modes**: `websocket-lanes` (default, one WebSocket per MTProto stream), `websocket` (multiplexed), `auto` (documented heuristic).
- **Protocol**: Telegram Desktop "WEB" proxy carrier: frames OPEN 0x01 / DATA 0x02 / CLOSE 0x03 / WINDOW 0x04 / PING 0x05 / PONG 0x06, 8-byte frame header, subprotocols `tproxy-v1.<token>` and `tproxy-lane-v1.<token>.<id>` — unchanged from v1.2.2 (byte-exact constraint).
- **Socket Driver**: `cloudflare:sockets` TCP with bounded failover (max 3 candidates, 3 s timeout each).
- **Middle-End & Ad Tags**: incompatible with Workers (egress NAPT source-port translation breaks ME key agreement); see docs/ME-notes.md.

## Configuration & Environment Variables (all actually read by the code)
- `ADMIN_KEY`: required for the panel (24+ mixed characters recommended). Legacy mode derives proxy secrets from it.
- `SECRET`: recommended independent 32-hex proxy secret (443 + base for other ports).
- `KEY_EPOCH`: changing it revokes all issued carrier tokens.
- `EXTRA_HOSTS`: comma-separated secondary domains.
- `DECOY_URL`: external decoy website (edge-cached 60 s).
- `CARRIER`: `websocket-lanes` (default) | `websocket` | `auto`.
- `HOSTNAME`: comma-separated host allowlist (default: all).
- `MAX_STREAMS`: max MTProto streams per session (default 6, max 32).
- `SESSION_PATH` / `WS_PATH`: carrier API paths (derived from the secret when unset; legacy `/api/v1/session` and `/api/v1/ws` accepted for one release).
- `DEBUG`: `true` for extra diagnostics.
- `UP_BATCH_BYTES` (262144), `DATA_CHUNK` (65536), `MAX_ISOLATE_QUEUED` (32 MB), `MAX_QUEUED` (16 MB), `SESSION_TTL` (21600), `BOOTSTRAP_TTL` (3600).
- `DC_OVERRIDE`: JSON DC list override (validated; invalid values are ignored and reported in /status).
- `USER_SECRETS`: comma-separated user labels; each gets a revocable derived secret.
- `LEGACY_PORT_SECRETS`: `1` restores v1.2.2 cross-port secret fallbacks.
- `ALERT_URL`: optional https webhook for alerts (never sends IPs, tokens or secrets).

## Admin & Diagnostics Endpoints
- **Login**: `https://<domain>/login` (POST form, secure cookie). URL-key access `https://<domain>/<ADMIN_KEY>` still works but is deprecated.
- **Panel**: `/panel` (cookie) or `/<ADMIN_KEY>` — links, QR codes, copy buttons, per-user secrets, latency test page (`/panel/latency`).
- **Status & DC probe**: `/panel/status` (or `/<ADMIN_KEY>/status`), `?probe=1` for the DC reachability check.

## Repository Files
- [worker.js](worker.js): built single-file deployable (esbuild output, committed).
- [src/](src): modular source of truth (build: `npm run build`).
- [test/](test): vitest suite (tokens, bridge capability, frame limits, ctrAt incl. unaligned positions, batching equivalence, decoy uniformity, golden legacy values).
- [README.md](README.md): Persian user documentation (primary). [docs/README.ru.md](docs/README.ru.md), [docs/README.zh.md](docs/README.zh.md): summaries.
- [docs/ME-notes.md](docs/ME-notes.md): why sponsored channels (ad tags) are impossible on Workers.
